WorkspaceLoader.LoadAsync returns Result<(MSBuildWorkspace workspace, Solution solution), RtError>.

The 'solution file not found' case produces Result.Err(RtError.NotFound) with the solution path in Context['solution']; the 'solution loaded but contains zero projects' case produces Result.Err(RtError.WorkspaceLoadFailure) with the failure-diagnostic text in Context['diagnostic'].

MSBuildWorkspace.WorkspaceFailed handler downgrades from throw to Result.Err when the diagnostic is a Failure rather than a Warning; warnings still flow through RtContext.ShowWorkspaceWarnings unchanged.
Every existing caller of WorkspaceLoader.LoadAsync is updated to consume the Result; commands surface RtError via the shared helper added in US-068a (no new helpers introduced here).
App.CaptureExceptionAsync no longer needs a FileNotFoundException branch specifically for solution-file-missing — that path is now Result-routed before the catch ladder runs.
Integration test: rt inspect describe Foo --solution missing.slnx exits 1 with exactly one 'Error: ...' line to stderr referencing the missing path; no stack trace; feedback.json count unchanged.
Integration test: rt inspect describe Foo --solution malformed.slnx (file exists but isn't a valid solution) exits 1 with RtError.WorkspaceLoadFailure formatting that includes the MSBuild diagnostic.
dotnet build clean; dotnet format --verify-no-changes clean; existing tests pass.
rt dogfood smoke: rt inspect describe RoslynTools.Core.WorkspaceLoader --solution RoslynTools.slnx still exits 0 with unchanged stdout JSON shape.
